entities.summary: Etanislao Toni "Tony" Abreu is a Dominican former professional baseball infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Los Angeles Dodgers, Arizona Diamondbacks, Kansas City Royals, and San Francisco Giants. He was a switch-hitter and threw right-handed.
